description: Identity Provider Directory Services Pollution An attacker could potentially exploit weaknesses in the Directory Services configuration or synchronization process to inject malicious mappings or modify existing ones. This could cause the Lambda authorizer to trust fraudulent identity claims. An attacker compromises the directory synchronization process to add their own identity mapping, then uses this to obtain valid access tokens from the Lambda authorizer.
references: recommendation: Implement strict validation and monitoring of Directory Services changes
recommendation: Enhance Lambda authorizer token validation

description: Cross-Account Role Assumption Attack The broker role has permission to assume roles in the target account. If compromised, an attacker could leverage this trust relationship to gain unauthorized access to resources in the target account. An attacker who compromises the broker role credentials could use sts:AssumeRole to gain access to the target account's elevated access role, potentially accessing sensitive resources.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1548 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism

description: Token Exfiltration and Session Fixation Tokens could be exfiltrated through MITM attacks, XSS vulnerabilities, or client-side malware. Once obtained, these tokens could be used to impersonate legitimate users. An attacker performs a MITM attack to capture access tokens in transit, then uses these tokens to make authenticated API calls to the system.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1528 - Steal Application Access Token
mitreATT&CK: T1550 - Use Alternate Authentication Material

description: Insufficient Monitoring and Detection Without proper logging and monitoring, attackers could perform reconnaissance, gain unauthorized access, or abuse elevated privileges without detection. An attacker gains access to the system and performs multiple failed role assumption attempts before succeeding, but the activity goes unnoticed due to insufficient monitoring.
references: owaspTop10: A09:2021-Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
recommendation: Implement comprehensive logging and monitoring

description: Lambda Authorizer Single Point of Compromise A vulnerability in the Lambda authorizer could be exploited to bypass authentication checks or generate valid tokens for unauthorized users. An attacker finds a bug in the token validation logic of the Lambda authorizer that allows them to bypass signature verification.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1548 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
recommendation: Implement defense in depth for authorization

description: DynamoDB Race Conditions and Data Integrity Concurrent operations on the same DynamoDB items could lead to race conditions where access requests are processed incorrectly or access is not properly revoked. An attacker exploits a race condition to maintain access after revocation by quickly creating a new request while the revocation is being processed.
